text: The Lost Treasure
Even after securing the giant tile dubbed the Sacred Tile by that mysterious voice, the situation remains perilous.
Frieren
Fern, watch our heads.
Fern
Leave it to me, Ms. Frieren.
Ichihime
Whoa, that defensive magic came out so fast, nyaa! Just as snappy as my All Simples, nyaa!
Fern casts defensive spells in rapid succession to intercept the falling debris, her aim never wavering even as she sprints.
Stark carves a path through the front with his axe, while Übel effortlessly cuts whatever obstacles remain.
Working together, we finally reach the exit.
Yuzu
Argh?! What happened to you guys? Look at this mess!
I have no idea, nyaa! The ruins just started collapsing out of nowhere, nyaa!
Maybe this is the Sacred Tile's doing again, nyaa...
Leia
At least everyone made it out unscathed.
I bet this tile holds the key to fixing everything, nyaa! Even if I don't quite know how it works yet...
Bringing it back with us is definitely the right play, nyaa!
N-no, you can't...
Hand it back... the Sacred Tile! You can't take it!
If you give it back, I'll trade you anything else you want...
Pearls, coral, tasty treats – anything!
Who are...
Lin Lang?
Is she someone you know?
Well, nyaa... She definitely sounds like Lin Lang, a close friend of ours who happens to be a dragon.
But something feels totally off about her, nyaa...
player
Wait, no! She's an imposter!
After all, Lin Lang would never willingly part with tasty treats.
Indeed, nyaa! The real Lin Lang would never do something like this in the first place, nyaa!
I see... An imposter, then.
On closer inspection, the figure resembling Lin Lang is shrouded in fog and doesn't seem to have a solid form.
Could she be... a mirage?
How sneaky, disguising as a little girl so we'd let our guard down, nyaa!
I didn't... I just...
So you're the big bad demon king pulling strings behind this fog, nyaa?
You better not try anything funny, nyaa! Just give yourself up, nyaa!
Demon king...? I don't know anything like that! I'm not a demon king!
But... if you don't return the Sacred Tile, I'll... I'll...
I'll trap you all in the fog forever!
Übel
By the way, you have such lovely hair... I bet it'll make a delightful sound when I snip through it.
Eek...!
Übel's "tender loving care" leaves the girl on the verge of tears.
If you're not the Demon King, why not step aside?
We're not bad guys, but this Sacred Tile is crucial.
You... really don't seem like one... Wait, no...
Even so, she stands her ground before us, trembling all over.
No, no! I... I can't let fear take over now!
That person taught me...!
Help me, Guardians of the Sacred Tile!
Guardian
Ichihime & Stark
A giant golem just showed up (nyaa)!!!
Looks like this won't be an easy fight.
Let's follow Master {var:player_nickname}'s advice and build a winning hand through our attacks.
A mahjong tile is knocked flying.
Yet the surrounding fog immediately coalesces to fill the gap, forming a block with a different tile pattern. The hand is still nowhere near complete.
The tile changed. A continuous assault might work better.
Ugh... You already figured out how the Guardians work?
But I can't give up...
Double Riichi!
Ngh?!
Unexpectedly, the monster splits in two, lunging from both sides at once.
Stark
Hey! Not only is this thing not going down, but it's multiplying?!
Does that hand even have yaku, nyaa?! Stop cheating, nyaa!
Damn it, so it's forcefully blocking us from declaring a win?!
Then, to completely shatter these monsters...
Th-there has to be a way, nyaa!
No matter how terrible the hand, victory is always possible... Mahjong is a realm of imagination, nyaa!
Imagination...
Indeed. Rather than assuming the enemy set an airtight board or played dirty...
The more likely truth is –
There actually is a yaku!
It's a special winning condition!
What did you figure out, Master?
A hand that seems yakuless yet ties into Double Riichi...
It's the local yaku Ishinouenimosannen (Three Years on a Stone), isn't it?
H-how did you... Eek!
Even so, realizing this does nothing to tip the scales in our current fight.
The other condition for this local yaku is pulling off Under the Sea.
Exactly... If we stall all the way to the final draw, you'll never hold out!
So just surrender...
Oh? Is that so? But I don't think staying like this is all that bad.
I can still fight.
Stark, keep holding them off. Can you do that?
...You just love bossing me around, huh?
Still, the odds are hardly in our favor.
Damn it, how are we even supposed to defeat...
Wait. Defeat?
Why do we have to win the hand?
Why can't we fold?
Declaring a win is just one way to knock the tiles over – it was never our real objective here.
All that matters is making the tiles fall.
I've got it!
Frieren, Fern, Übel... and Yuzu.
I'm counting on you!
You've come up with a plan, haven't you?
Tell us what to do, Master {var:player_nickname}.
What's the plan? Are we taking them down?
We don't need to defeat them.
Mahjong is a realm of imagination.
Everyone, strike the monsters on my mark – all at once!
Three!
Argh... I don't quite get how this works, but as the Witch of Justice, I'm ready to give it my all!
Two!
This trick of yours sounds pretty fun, {var:player_nickname}.
One!
I will give it everything I have!
Now!
<color=#6CC2B6>Zoltraak!</color>
Blasts from all four staffs strike the monsters' defenses at the exact same moment.
I-it's useless!
Brute force won't beat me...!
You're wrong.
This isn't brute force, and we're not trying to beat you...
Draw!
The moment the call rings out, the monsters freeze as if bound by magic.
If two golems count as Double Riichi, it's only logical that four spell strikes from the same direction would trigger a Four-Wind Discarded.
Sunlight finally bathes the island, dispelling the shroud of fog that once entombed it.
Th-that's impossible! Ugh...
Though she grits her teeth in frustration, without her Guardians, she's completely out of moves.
Can we calm down and talk this over now?
Exactly, nyaa! Why interfere with my heroic quest to save the world, nyaa?!
Even if this Sacred Tile belongs to you, you shouldn't use its power to stir up trouble.
S-stir up trouble...?
A look of innocent confusion crosses her face – she doesn't seem to be pretending.
We briefly fill her in on what has transpired.
Regardless, the spreading fog is no small matter.
Why did you do this?
B-because...
Her voice trails off, at a loss for words.
It's okay. Tell us what's on your mind.
Sensing she isn't inherently evil, I think there might be a genuine reason behind her actions.
After wrestling with her thoughts, she finally opens her mouth.
Truth is... I –
Then, their forms fade away completely.
Whew, nyaa... My heart is practically leaping out of my chest, nyaa...
Things are getting interesting... Though I'd rather not be trapped here.
Hmm... Getting its entire body in view looks tricky. Sorganeil probably won't work here.
